records.title: Physics‐Informed Deep Learning Method for Real‐Time Multi‐Harmonic Beamforming Based on Space‐Time‐Coding Metasurface
records.abstract: ABSTRACT Space‐time‐coding metasurfaces (STCMs) enable simultaneous controls of electromagnetic wave across multiple harmonics, but designing high‐performance coding sequences in real time remains challenging. Here, we propose an unsupervised physics‐informed deep learning framework that can generate optimal spatiotemporal coding patterns for arbitrary single‐ and dual‐beam requirements at each harmonic frequency. records.title: Designing lipid nanoparticles using a transformer-based neural network
records.abstract: The RNA medicine revolution has been spurred by lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). records.title: Safe Path Planning via Multi-Objective Distributional Reinforcement Learning
records.abstract: Ensuring safe and efficient trajectory planning in dynamic marine environments poses fundamental challenges for autonomous platforms. We propose a novel reinforcement learning framework that integrates distributional value estimation with continuous control under formal safety constraints. records.title: Reward-free Alignment for Conflicting Objectives
records.abstract: Direct alignment methods are increasingly used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences.
